diarrhoea_grade.label: Current diarrhoea grade

options.label: Grade 0 — No toxicity
options.description: No increase above the patient's usual stool frequency or ostomy output.

options.label: Grade 1 — Mild
options.description: Increase of fewer than 4 stools per day above baseline, or mild increase in ostomy output.

options.label: Grade 2 — Moderate
options.description: Increase of 4–6 stools per day above baseline, or moderate increase in ostomy output; limits instrumental activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 3 — Severe
options.description: Increase of 7 or more stools per day above baseline, incontinence, hospital care indicated, or severe ostomy-output increase; limits self-care activities of daily living.

options.label: Grade 4 — Life-threatening
options.description: Life-threatening consequences; urgent intervention required.

diarrhoea_grade.assessment_guidance: Grade using increase in stools over baseline, ostomy output, need for hospitalisation and impact on self-care; do not grade from the word “diarrhoea” alone.

action.recommendation: Outside the NCCP ECOG eligibility range; review suitability.

rules.explanation: Outside the NCCP ECOG eligibility range; review suitability.

action.recommendation: Known hypersensitivity is an NCCP exclusion.

rules.explanation: Known hypersensitivity is an NCCP exclusion.

action.recommendation: Pregnancy or breastfeeding requires specialist review; do not give routine treatment clearance. Follow the medicine-specific pregnancy, contraception and breastfeeding precautions.

rules.explanation: Pregnancy or breastfeeding requires specialist review; do not give routine treatment clearance. Follow the medicine-specific pregnancy, contraception and breastfeeding precautions.

action.recommendation: Urgent assessment and treatment of fever / active infection; defer chemotherapy pending review.

rules.explanation: Urgent assessment and treatment of fever / active infection; defer chemotherapy pending review.

action.recommendation: Hold chemotherapy for ANC <1.5 ×10⁹/L; repeat counts and assess recovery and nadir before restart.

rules.explanation: Hold chemotherapy for ANC <1.5 ×10⁹/L; repeat counts and assess recovery and nadir before restart.

action.recommendation: Hold chemotherapy for platelets <75 ×10⁹/L; assess recovery before restart.

rules.explanation: Hold chemotherapy for platelets <75 ×10⁹/L; assess recovery before restart.

action.recommendation: NCCP specifies a 15–20% irinotecan reduction after these haematological events. Select the dose with consultant/pharmacy; do not invent a single percentage.

rules.explanation: NCCP specifies a 15–20% irinotecan reduction after these haematological events. Select the dose with consultant/pharmacy; do not invent a single percentage.

action.recommendation: Bowel obstruction / chronic bowel disease is an irinotecan exclusion.

rules.explanation: Bowel obstruction / chronic bowel disease is an irinotecan exclusion.

action.recommendation: Severe bone marrow failure excludes irinotecan treatment.

rules.explanation: Severe bone marrow failure excludes irinotecan treatment.

action.recommendation: Immediate clinical assessment; atropine according to NCCP and local policy after checking contraindications. Distinguish this from delayed diarrhoea.

rules.explanation: Immediate clinical assessment; atropine according to NCCP and local policy after checking contraindications. Distinguish this from delayed diarrhoea.

action.recommendation: Consider reduced irinotecan starting dose and enhanced toxicity monitoring; no fixed source percentage.

rules.explanation: Consider reduced irinotecan starting dose and enhanced toxicity monitoring; no fixed source percentage.

action.recommendation: Treatment-related diarrhoea must be fully resolved before irinotecan; assess hydration, infection and bowel baseline.

rules.explanation: Treatment-related diarrhoea must be fully resolved before irinotecan; assess hydration, infection and bowel baseline.

action.recommendation: Allow treatment-related adverse events to recover to grade 0–1 before irinotecan.

rules.explanation: Allow treatment-related adverse events to recover to grade 0–1 before irinotecan.

action.recommendation: NCCP gives no routine irinotecan renal reduction but cautions that evidence is limited. Review clinical suitability; do not borrow the <10 mL/min dose range from other regimens.

rules.explanation: NCCP gives no routine irinotecan renal reduction but cautions that evidence is limited. Review clinical suitability; do not borrow the <10 mL/min dose range from other regimens.

action.recommendation: Source monotherapy starting dose is 200 mg/m² in the >1.5–3 ×ULN bilirubin band. Confirm performance status, coagulation and weekly FBC monitoring; lower boundary is assigned to ≤1.5 band.

rules.explanation: Source monotherapy starting dose is 200 mg/m² in the >1.5–3 ×ULN bilirubin band. Confirm performance status, coagulation and weekly FBC monitoring; lower boundary is assigned to ≤1.5 band.

action.recommendation: The source bilirubin table describes starting doses. Reconcile previous dose, toxicity and current liver function before a subsequent dose.

rules.explanation: The source bilirubin table describes starting doses. Reconcile previous dose, toxicity and current liver function before a subsequent dose.

action.recommendation: After recovery to grade ≤1 and fully resolved diarrhoea, consider a 15–20% irinotecan reduction. No single percentage is selected automatically.

rules.explanation: After recovery to grade ≤1 and fully resolved diarrhoea, consider a 15–20% irinotecan reduction. No single percentage is selected automatically.

action.recommendation: If toxicity has not recovered after two weeks, consider discontinuing irinotecan with consultant review.

rules.explanation: If toxicity has not recovered after two weeks, consider discontinuing irinotecan with consultant review.

eligibility: Indication as listed in the current official NCCP regimen
Performance status and organ function appropriate for the selected treatment
exclusions: Known hypersensitivity to a regimen component
Pregnancy or breastfeeding where prohibited by the current source
monitoring: FBC, renal and liver profile as specified by the current NCCP regimen
Treatment-specific toxicity monitoring before each administration/cycle
dose_modifications: Use source-mapped component rules below. Relative reductions require the actual current component dose level; do not assume level 0. Source ambiguities require consultant/pharmacy clarification.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Risk assigned from the most emetogenic active component and treatment phase.
supportive_care.supportive_medications_label: NCCP antiemetic guidance for moderate emetogenic risk
supportive_care.premedication: Antiemetics per NCCP/local moderate-risk protocol. Assess prophylactic atropine suitability; separate delayed-diarrhoea plan.
other_supportive_care: Symptom-led support, hydration and urgent contact plan.
No home fluorouracil pump in this regimen.
